name: mma-local
description: MMA game on the octagon: three.js, plain ES modules, no build step

scripts.assets: cd .. && python3 tools/build_arena.py && python3 tools/populate.py && python3 tools/stl_to_glb.py --scales && python3 tools/autorig.py && python3 tools/animate.py
